The '''80Z telescopic optical sight''' was a type of [[Scope/Legends|scope]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and sold for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The system was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Core Rulebook" />
